P8-03.scope_note: The file expressly assumes general ATR coverage; company DTI screen and ARM illustration do not replace required determination

P8-04.scope_note: Different from the six-element TRID definition; creditor actual practices and reasonable diligence matter

P8-05.reference: P8-05: CFPB Regulation B §1002.6(a) and (b)(5): current evaluation standards and income
P8-05.scope_note: Individual amount/continuance review; no automatic pension discount; current effects-test boundary

P8-06.reference: P8-06: CFPB Regulation B §1002.4(a), (b), and current interpretations: treatment and discouragement
P8-06.scope_note: Current directed-statement formulation and concrete disparate-treatment concerns

P8-07.reference: P8-07: Federal Register 91 FR 21620–21670, April 22 2026 Regulation B final rule, effective July 21 2026
P8-07.scope_note: Official GovInfo final-rule PDF corroborates effective date and amended scope; no assumption about all other law or court orders

P8-08.reference: P8-08: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B2-1.2-01: Loan-to-Value Ratios
P8-08.scope_note: Ordinary purchase method uses lower of price or current appraised value; case supplies no exception. Guide truncates the calculated ratio to two decimal places, then rounds up to the nearest whole percent for delivery. For 360000/440000, mathematical classroom display is 81.82%; truncation is 81.81%; delivery is 82%.

P8-09.reference: P8-09: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-4.3-17: Personal Unsecured Loans
P8-09.scope_note: Unsecured personal-loan proceeds not acceptable for down payment, closing costs or financial reserves

P8-10.reference: P8-10: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-6-01: General Information on Liabilities
P8-10.scope_note: Verify relevant liabilities, including those absent from report, and recalculate for discovered debt through closing

P8-11.reference: P8-11: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-6-07: Debts Paid Off At or Prior to Closing
P8-11.scope_note: Careful evaluation of payoff/paydown for qualification; actual exclusion in case stipulated accepted after review

P8-12.reference: P8-12: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-3.1-01: General Income Information
P8-12.scope_note: Income history, stability and continuance; accepted amounts in this fictional file are stipulated

P8-13.reference: P8-13: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-6-05: Monthly Debt Obligations, page dated August 5 2026
P8-13.scope_note: Installment obligations and program-specific debt treatment; no universal student-loan amount inferred

P8-14.reference: P8-14: CFPB Regulation Z §1026.42: valuation independence and permitted requests
P8-14.scope_note: Relevant correction requests distinguished from pressure for target value

P8-15.reference: P8-15: CFPB Regulation B §1002.14: appraisal and valuation notices and copies
P8-15.scope_note: Copy compliance distinct from collateral acceptance; lesson stipulates applicable notice/copy requirements satisfied

P8-18.reference: P8-18: CFPB Regulation X §1024.17: escrow accounts, analyses and applicable balances
P8-18.scope_note: Escrow changes distinguished from rate changes; actual analysis and amounts govern

P8-19.reference: P8-19: CFPB Regulation X §1024.14: kickbacks, unearned fees, referral agreements and permissible payments
P8-19.scope_note: Separate lawful consumer correction from proposed referral bargain

P8-20.reference: P8-20: CFPB Regulation Z §1026.36(e): steering and compensation-related restrictions

P8-21.reference: P8-21: CFPB Regulation B §1002.9: notifications and incomplete applications
P8-21.scope_note: Actual status, decision and notices require review; operational hold not automatically a denial

P8-22.reference: P8-22: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-2-01: General Information on DU, page dated April 1 2026
P8-22.scope_note: Accurate data and lender responsibilities persist despite automated recommendation

P8-23.reference: P8-23: HUD Fair Housing Rights and Obligations
P8-23.scope_note: Fair Housing framework distinct from ECOA; do not infer that a Reg B amendment removes other protections

P8-24.reference: P8-24: CFPB Consumer Handbook on Adjustable Rate Mortgages
P8-24.scope_note: ARM index, margin, caps and payment-change concepts; all lesson rates and computations are original assumptions

P8-25.reference: P8-25: FTC Safeguards Rule What Your Business Needs to Know
P8-25.scope_note: Covered institutions and appropriate safeguards; no incident-reporting deadline invented

P8-26.reference: P8-26: CFPB Regulation Z §1026.36(c)(3): payoff statements
P8-26.scope_note: Accurate payoff for a specified date; exercise daily-interest convention and numbers expressly stipulated

P8-27.reference: P8-27: CFPB Regulation B §1002.12: record retention
P8-27.scope_note: Preserve applicable application evidence and honor extended requirements; lesson supplies no universal destruction date

P8-28.reference: P8-28: CFPB Mortgage Closing Scams How to Protect Yourself and Your Closing Funds, archived official education
P8-28.scope_note: Independently established contact channel for wire verification; no outdated statistics reused

P8-29.reference: P8-29: CFPB Regulation Z §1026.22: APR determination and accuracy
P8-29.scope_note: APR distinguished from note rate and payment calculation; no hand-calculated APR offered

P8-30.reference: P8-30: CFPB Regulation X §1024.34(b): escrow balances upon payoff
P8-30.scope_note: Actual post-payoff escrow disposition is separate from money available now; no refund amount or timing is promised in the case
